name: the_third_line
conceit: A rehearsed speech never gets to finish: a lone figure walks a road alone (rehearsing what he'll say), the run interrupts him mid-approach, and the landing is an embrace that cuts off the planned words entirely -- the device is the gap between the line a character rehearsed and the event that actually happens to him.

anti: a beat with no rehearsed or anticipated line of dialogue to interrupt -- the device needs a real 'planned words vs. actual event' gap, not just any emotional scene

plate_bill.must_contain: a lone ragged robed figure walking alone in the distance on a dusty road, small in frame, the road stretching toward a distant home, warm late-afternoon light
wide view of a dusty road: an older robed figure running toward a smaller ragged figure in the middle distance, both mid-motion, arms outstretched, dust caught in the air
close view of two robed figures embracing, an older figure's arms wrapped around a smaller ragged figure bowed with his face hidden against the older man's shoulder, warm golden light

motion_slots.earned_by: the run itself (P2) is the one beat worth a paid clip -- real closing-distance motion; the rehearsal and the embrace hold as $0 stills either side of it.

beat_template.hook: alone on the road, rehearsing the line he means to say
beat_template.pivot: the run, interrupted mid-approach, before the line can land
beat_template.landing: the embrace -- the rehearsed line never finishes, unneeded

score_shape: a lone, walking, minor-key figure under the rehearsal, breaking into a running swell as the two figures close the distance, resolving into one sustained warm held chord through the silent embrace.
